---
title: "Deploy & Secret Guard"
---

In an infrastructure repo the costly mistakes are a `terraform destroy` against prod, a deleted namespace, or a secret copied into the transcript where it lands in logs forever. This example blocks all three before they run.

<!-- gd-embed: deploy_secret_guard.py -->

**What to learn.** `block_command` with a regex stops a known-dangerous invocation, and a handler on `PreToolUse` with `Tool("Bash")` inspects the command for secret-exfiltration patterns a prefix match would miss. Every block carries a reason the agent reads and acts on. The hooks fire on `PreToolUse`. See [Gate, block, and warn on commands](../guide/primitives.qmd) and the [Command Safety](command-safety.qmd) example.
